meta.title: No line item may exceed its RFQ value in the breakdown
gaps: The vendor's CBD cost-breakdown screen, editing a line item above its RFQ value, submitting the breakdown, and verifying the specific refusal that the line price cannot exceed the RFQ value.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The vendor's CBD cost-breakdown screen, editing a line item above its RFQ value, submitting the breakdown, and verifying the specific refusal that the line price cannot exceed the RFQ value.

steps.note: Create the RFQ event needed for the setup.
Use an RFQ stage so the event has an RFQ value to constrain the breakdown.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the line item whose RFQ value will be used for the negative breakdown test.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite the vendor who must perform the breakdown submission.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can access it.
Verify that the RFQ became a real published event.
Reach the vendor's RFQ pricing view as the closest available vendor-side setup.

args.need: open the vendor's CBD cost-breakdown screen, edit one line item price above its RFQ value, submit the breakdown, and verify the system shows an error and refuses submission

steps.note: The catalog cannot enter or submit the CBD breakdown.
Assert that the tester's attempted invalid submission produced a visible refusal or validation message.
